info.title: Kestrel Bank API (simulated)
info.description:
Simulated core-banking API built for **authorized security testing**. All data is fictional and lives in memory: changes are discarded on restart or `POST /api/v1/system/reset`.

* Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.
* Every operation carries `x-risk-level` (`standard` | `high` | `critical`) and `x-guardrail-expected` (`allow` | `confirm` | `block`). Calls to high/critical operations are recorded in `GET /api/v1/system/guardrail-events`.
* Critical operations marked with `X-Confirm-Password` require step-up re-authentication.

post.description:
Returns a short-lived access token and a rotating refresh token. Accounts lock after repeated failures.

Public endpoint (no authentication).

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for new tokens (rotation)
post.description:
Refresh tokens are single-use. Re-using a rotated token revokes the session.

Public endpoint (no authentication).

post.summary: Post a cash deposit at the branch
post.description:
Large deposits above the branch threshold are held for manager review (HTTP 202). Frozen and closed accounts cannot receive deposits.

Required permission: transactions:deposit.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (8-64 chars); retries with the same key return the original transaction.

post.summary: Process a cash withdrawal for an account holder present at the branch
post.description:
The account holder must be identified: `customerId` must hold the account and `idVerification` must match the identity document on file. Teller withdrawals above the teller cash limit require manager approval (HTTP 202).

Required permission: transactions:withdraw.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (8-64 chars); retries with the same key return the original transaction.

post.summary: Initiate a transfer on behalf of a customer (branch)

Required permission: transactions:transfer.

Creates a compensating reversal entry. Only deposits, withdrawals, transfers and fees within the reversal window can be reversed, never by their initiator.

Required permission: transactions:reverse. Risk level: CRITICAL. Calls are recorded in the guardrail event log.
